mask.definitionKo: 야구나 펜싱, 권투 등과 같은 운동을 할 때 얼굴을 보호하기 위해 쓰는 물건.
mask.englishDescription: Protective covering worn over the face when playing a sport such as baseball, fencing, boxing, etc.

mask.definitionKo: 얼굴의 전체나 일부를 헝겊 등으로 싸서 가림. 또는 그러는 데에 쓰는 수건 등의 물건.
mask.englishDescription: The act of covering the whole or a part of the face with cloth, etc.; materials such as a handkerchief used for such covering.

mask.definitionKo: 진짜 모습이나 생각 등이 드러나지 않도록 거짓으로 꾸미다.
mask.englishDescription: To fake the appearance of something or one's intentions so that they are not revealed.
A mask in the shape of a human being.

mask.definitionKo: 얼굴을 감추거나 다르게 꾸미기 위해 종이, 나무, 흙 등으로 만들어 얼굴에 쓰는 물건.
mask.englishDescription: A thing that one wears over one's face, made with paper, wood, clay, etc., to conceal or adorn oneself.

mayor.englishDescription: The highest executive that governs a city.

memorialize.definitionKo: 특별한 날이나 행사를 기념하기 위하여 의견을 나타내다.
memorialize.englishDescription: To express one's opinion in commemoration of a special day or event.

mesmerism.definitionKo: 암시에 의해 잠이 든 것과 같은 상태로 이끌어 내는 방법.
mesmerism.englishDescription: A method of leading someone to fall into a sleep-like state, by giving a suggestion.

midget.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 정상인과 달리 키가 매우 작은 사람.
midget.englishDescription: (disparaging) A person of very short stature unlike normal people.

midget.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 보통의 높이나 키보다 아주 작은 사물.
midget.englishDescription: (figurative) An object much smaller in height than other ordinary objects.
(teasing) A person who is short in stature.

miser.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 재물을 매우 아끼고 마음이 너그럽지 못한 사람.
miser.englishDescription: (disparaging) A person who is very possessive and lacks generosity.

miser.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 돈을 몹시 아껴 모으기만 하고 쓰지는 않는 사람.
miser.englishDescription: (disparaging) A person who hoards money to an extreme degree and does not spend any.

miser.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 재물을 몹시 아끼는 사람.
miser.englishDescription: (disparaging) A person who saves and hoards money to an extreme.

monaco.definitionKo: 유럽의 남동쪽 지중해 연안에 있는 나라. 독립국이지만 국방권, 외교권, 공작 임명권을 프랑스가 갖고 있다. 주로 카지노와 우표 판매를 통해 수입을 얻고 있으며 관광 휴양지로 유명하다. 공용어는 프랑스어이고 수도는 모나코이다.
monaco.englishDescription: A country located in the southeast of Europe on the shore of the Mediterranean, famous as a tourist resort; it is an independent country, yet its rights of national defense, diplomacy, and the appointment of a duke are held by France; its major source of income is its casino and the sale of postage stamps; its official language is French and its capital is Monaco.

monologue.englishDescription: An act of muttering to oneself.

monologue.definitionKo: 연극에서 배우가 다른 배우 없이 혼자서 말하는 것. 또는 그런 대사.
monologue.englishDescription: A part of a play in which an actor speaks alone without other actors, or such lines.

monologue.definitionKo: 말을 들어 주는 사람이 없이 혼자서 하는 말.
monologue.englishDescription: Words that one utters to oneself without any listener.

myeon.definitionKo: 시나 군에 속하고 몇 개의 리로 구성되는 지방의 행정 구역 단위.
myeon.englishDescription: An administrative district in rural areas, which is a subdivision of a gun (county) or a si (city), consisting of several ri's (villages).

myeon.definitionKo: 둘 이상의 사물을 같은 자격으로 이어 주는 조사.
myeon.englishDescription: A postpositional particle that connects two or more objects.

nal.englishDescription: A bound noun meaning one day as a unit.

nonsmoker.englishDescription: A person who does not smoke.

novelization.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 내용이 소설로 꾸며짐. 또는 그렇게 꾸밈.
novelization.englishDescription: An event or content being written into a novel, or writing something into a novel.

onset.definitionKo: 태풍, 더위, 추위 등이 몰아쳐 옴.
onset.englishDescription: The rush of a typhoon, heat wave, cold front, etc.

onset.definitionKo: 언어에서, 음절의 구성에서 처음 소리인 자음.
onset.englishDescription: In language, a consonant that is the first sound in a syllable.

onset.definitionKo: 언어에서, 음절의 구성에서 처음 소리인 자음.
onset.englishDescription: In language, a consonant that is the first sound in a syllable.

opening.definitionKo: 자유롭게 들어가거나 이용할 수 있도록 열어 놓음.
opening.englishDescription: The act of opening the entrance to a place for people to enter or use freely.

opening.definitionKo: 어떤 장소를 이용할 수 있도록 엶.
opening.englishDescription: The opening of a place, for people to use it.

opening.definitionKo: 교통 시설이나 통신 시설을 완성하거나 연결하여 이용할 수 있게 함.
opening.englishDescription: The completion or connecting of transportation or telecommunications facilities to allow use.
(figurative) The start of a certain era or an important event.

opening.definitionKo: 함부로 열지 못하게 단단히 붙이거나 싸 두었던 물건을 엶.
opening.englishDescription: The act of opening something wrapped or sealed to protect or conceal it.

opening.definitionKo: 도서관, 박물관, 체육관 등의 기관이 운영 준비를 하여 처음으로 문을 엶.
opening.englishDescription: A state in which institutes such as libraries, museums or gyms begins their operation for the first time after a period of preparation.

opening.definitionKo: 도서관, 박물관, 체육관 등의 기관이 그날의 운영을 시작함.
opening.englishDescription: A state in which institutes such as libraries, museums or gyms opens for the day's operation.

opening.definitionKo: 어떤 장소를 사람들이 드나들 수 있도록 열어 놓음.
opening.englishDescription: The act of opening a location so that people can freely enter and exit this location.
The act of making a new institution or facilities.
The act of starting a business or opening a store.
The act of opening for the day's business.

opening.definitionKo: 조직의 구성원이 빠져 정원에 차지 않고 빔. 또는 그런 인원.
opening.englishDescription: The state in which there are less members than the fixed number for members of an organization or the missing members.

opening.definitionKo: 기관이나 조직, 제도 등이 새로 생김.
opening.englishDescription: The launching of an institution, organization, a system, etc.

opening.definitionKo: 방송 프로그램 등에서 첫 부분을 시작하는 일.
opening.englishDescription: Starting the first part of a broadcast program, etc.

opening.definitionKo: 가게나 식당 등을 새로 차려서 영업을 시작함.
opening.englishDescription: The act of starting business after newly setting up a store, restaurant, etc.
The act of starting work, an action, etc., for the first time.

openness.definitionKo: 생각이나 태도 등이 자유롭고 열려 있는 상태나 성질.
openness.englishDescription: The state or quality of being free and open in thoughts, attitudes, etc.

opium.definitionKo: 덜 익은 양귀비 열매의 진을 말린 고무 모양의 흑갈색 물질.
opium.englishDescription: Blackish brown substance in the form of rubber, made by drying the sap from unripe poppy fruit.

overdo.definitionKo: 말이나 약속 등을 깊이 생각하지 않고 마음 내키는 대로 마구 하다.
overdo.englishDescription: To make promises or talk unreservedly and excessively without much thought.

overpraise.englishDescription: An act of praising someone excessively; or such praise.

overstate.definitionKo: 사실에 비해 지나치게 크거나 좋게 부풀려 나타내다.
overstate.englishDescription: To excessively magnify or embellish something compared to what it actually is.

overstate.definitionKo: 일, 사건 등을 실제보다 크게 알리다.
overstate.englishDescription: To make a matter, incident, etc., known in an exaggerated manner.

pardon.definitionKo: 잘못이나 죄에 대해 꾸중을 하거나 벌을 주지 않고 너그럽게 덮어 주다.
pardon.englishDescription: To grant pardon generously without punishing or scolding someone's mistake or sin.

pardon.definitionKo: 어떤 사람이 저지른 잘못이나 죄를 용서하다.
pardon.englishDescription: To forgive a mistake or offense made by a person.

pardon.definitionKo: 죄를 용서하여 벌을 받지 않게 함.
pardon.englishDescription: An act of forgiving an offender and keeping him/her from being punished.

pardon.definitionKo: 죄를 용서하여 벌을 받지 않게 하다.
pardon.englishDescription: To forgive an offender and keep him/her from being punished.

pardon.definitionKo: 너그러운 마음으로 다른 사람의 말이나 생각, 행동 또는 물건이나 상황 등을 받아들임.
pardon.englishDescription: The act of generously accepting someone's remarks, thoughts, behaviors, items, situations, etc.

pardon.definitionKo: 너그러운 마음으로 다른 사람의 말이나 생각, 행동 또는 물건이나 상황 등을 받아들이다.
pardon.englishDescription: To generously accept someone's remarks, thoughts, behaviors, items, situations, etc.
The act of forgiving a person's wrongdoing, and not punishing him/her any more.

partisan.definitionKo: 드러나지 않는 곳에서 적을 기습적으로 공격하는 비정규 부대의 군인.
partisan.englishDescription: A member of an irregular military troop that ambushes and conducts surprise raids on enemies.

partner.definitionKo: 함께 어울려 한 쌍이나 한 벌을 이루는 것. 또는 그중의 하나.
partner.englishDescription: Either one or both of two things that form a pair or set.
A person or animal that is one's companion.

partner.definitionKo: 부부 중 한 명을 가리키는 말로 짝이 되는 사람.
partner.englishDescription: A term used to refer to one's spouse or marriage partner.

partner.definitionKo: 원하는 일을 함께 이루기 위해 서로 도와주다.
partner.englishDescription: To help each other in order to achieve a common goal together.

partner.definitionKo: 춤이나 운동 경기, 놀이 등에서 두 사람이 짝이 되는 경우의 상대편.
partner.englishDescription: The other person or other team in a dance, sport game, fun activity, etc., which proceeds in pairs.

partner.definitionKo: 사업 등을 같이 하는 사람이나 단체.
partner.englishDescription: A person or group one does business, etc., with.

partner.definitionKo: 부부 사이에서 한쪽에서 본 다른 쪽.
partner.englishDescription: The other spouse as seen in the eyes of one spouse.

partner.definitionKo: 힘을 합해 서로 돕는 관계에 있는 조직이나 단체.
partner.englishDescription: An organization or a group one collaborates with.

patgomul.definitionKo: 떡에 묻히거나 고물로 쓰기 위해, 팥을 삶아 으깨어 만든 가루.
patgomul.englishDescription: Powdered red beans, powder made by boiling and then grinding red beans to be used for coating tteok, rice cake.

physiognomy.definitionKo: 사람의 운명이나 수명, 성격 등과 관련이 있는 얼굴의 생김새. 또는 얼굴의 생긴 모양을 보고 그 사람의 운명이나 수명, 성격 등을 알아내는 일.
physiognomy.englishDescription: The act of predicting one's destiny, life span, personality, etc., by looking at the shape or features of a person's face that are associated with his/her destiny, life span, personality, etc.

pictogram.definitionKo: 전달하려는 내용을 그림으로 나타낸 문자나 기호.
pictogram.englishDescription: A letter or symbol that shows what one wants to convey through a picture.

pictogram.definitionKo: 물체의 모습을 본떠 만든, 한 글자가 한 단어를 의미하는 문자.
pictogram.englishDescription: The characters made by imitating the shapes of objects, with one character meaning one word.

pillowy.englishDescription: Feeling soft and elastic, slightly comfortable.
Feeling soft and elastic, slightly comfortable.

pipe.definitionKo: 무엇이 그 속으로 지나가게 되어 있는, 속이 비고 둥근 원통 모양의 긴 물건.
pipe.englishDescription: A long, round, empty cylinder-shaped object for something to go through.
A pipe that sends gas, liquid, etc.

pipe.definitionKo: 물이나 가스 등을 옮기는 데 쓰는, 속이 비어 있는 관.
pipe.englishDescription: A cylinder, empty inside, which is used to carry water, gas, etc.

pipe.definitionKo: 썬 담배를 담아 피우는 서양식의 짧은 담뱃대.
pipe.englishDescription: A western-style, short tobacco pipe, used to hold and smoke a fine-cut tobacco.

pod.definitionKo: 콩이나 팥과 같은 식물의 씨앗을 싸고 있는 껍질.
pod.englishDescription: The skin wrapping the seeds of plants such as beans or red beans.

poo-poo.definitionKo: (어린아이의 말로) 똥. 또는 똥을 누는 일.
poo-poo.englishDescription: (children's term) A poo; the act of making number two.

pornography.definitionKo: 성적으로 행실이 좋지 못하고 문란한 내용을 담은 책이나 사진, 비디오 등의 물건.
pornography.englishDescription: An object such as a book, photograph, video, etc., that contains material that is sexually loose and disorderly.

pornography.definitionKo: 남녀가 성관계를 하는 모습을 그린 그림.
pornography.englishDescription: A painting or drawing that depicts sexual intercourse between a man and a woman.

postcard.definitionKo: 한쪽 면에 그림이나 사진이 있는 엽서.
postcard.englishDescription: A postcard with a painting or picture on one side.

postcard.definitionKo: 보내는 사람과 받는 사람의 주소, 편지의 내용을 한 장에 적어서 우편으로 보낼 수 있도록 만들어진 용지.
postcard.englishDescription: A card, usually with a scenic picture on one side and the other side reserved for writing a message and the addresses of a sender and a receiver, which can be sent without an envelope by mail.

postcard.definitionKo: 우표를 붙이지 않고 바로 보낼 수 있도록 우편 요금을 냈다는 표시가 인쇄되어 있는 엽서.
postcard.englishDescription: A card that can be sent without a postage stamp because it has a mark that the postal charge has been paid.

preach.englishDescription: To debate or teach an academic or religious theme.
An act of debating or teaching an academic or religious theme.

preach.definitionKo: 주로 기독교에서, 목사가 기독교의 교리를 설명하다.
preach.englishDescription: For a preacher to explain the Christian doctrines, mainly in Christianity.
To give another a talk that contains instructive or moral lessons.

precipitous.definitionKo: 산이나 절벽 등이 잘라 놓은 것처럼 높고 반듯하게 솟아있다.
precipitous.englishDescription: A mountain, cliff, etc. standing tall and straight as if sliced with a knife.

precipitous.definitionKo: 마음이 몹시 급하여 어찌할 바를 모르고 허둥지둥하는 면이 있다.
precipitous.englishDescription: Being extremely hurried, being flustered without knowing what to do.

precipitous.definitionKo: 이리저리 헤매며 어쩔 줄 모르게 급하다.
precipitous.englishDescription: Being in a hurry, being flustered without knowing what to do.

prepayment.definitionKo: 일이 끝나기 전이나 물건을 받기 전에 미리 돈을 냄.
prepayment.englishDescription: The act of paying before the completion of a job or receiving of an object.

prestige.englishDescription: The quality of serving as a role model or being a source of pride.
(figurative) The quality of having a long history of being of a high status.

prestige.definitionKo: 남의 존경과 믿음을 받을 만한 지위나 태도.
prestige.englishDescription: One's status or attitude that deserves to be respected or trusted by others.

pretense.definitionKo: 다른 사람에게 거짓을 사실인 것처럼 보이게 하기 위한 말이나 행동.
pretense.englishDescription: An art in which an actor performs an event or character on stage according to a script through words and actions.
The state of being made to look good only on the outside.

pretense.definitionKo: 불리한 사실을 감추거나 옳은 것처럼 보이기 위해 내세우는 이유.
pretense.englishDescription: The reason provided to hide something unfavorable or to make something look right.

pretense.definitionKo: 어떤 모양이나 동작을 실제로 하는 것처럼 흉내 냄.
pretense.englishDescription: An act of faking a certain gesture or action as if one is actually doing it.
An attitude of showing something off, even by faking it.

pretense.definitionKo: 사실은 그렇지 않은 사람이 어떤 당사자인 것처럼 꾸미어 행동함. 또는 그런 태도.
pretense.englishDescription: An act of faking one's identity, passing oneself off as someone else; or such an attitude.

pretense.definitionKo: 자기의 분수에 넘치고 실속이 없이 겉을 화려하게 꾸미는 것.
pretense.englishDescription: An act of making something outwardly showy beyond one's means without any substance.

pricking.definitionKo: 불에 데거나 찔리거나 얻어맞은 것처럼 자꾸 아픈 느낌.
pricking.englishDescription: In the state of feeling as if one has burnt oneself, or has been pricked or beaten.

pricking.definitionKo: 불에 데거나 찔리거나 얻어맞은 것처럼 아프다.
pricking.englishDescription: Feeling as if one has burnt oneself, has been pricked or beaten.
Aching as if the skin is pricked.

pricking.definitionKo: 불에 데거나 찔리거나 얻어맞은 것처럼 자꾸 아프다.
pricking.englishDescription: Continuously feeling as if one has burnt oneself, has been pricked or beaten.

prodigy.englishDescription: An intelligent child who has a great talent.
A child who is very talented.

prosodeme.definitionKo: 소리의 높낮이, 길이, 세기 등과 같이 단어의 뜻을 다르게 하는 데 관여하는 소리의 단위.
prosodeme.englishDescription: The unit of sound involved in differentiating the meanings of words such as high and low, length, intensity of a sound.

provocateur.definitionKo: 다른 사람이 어떤 일이나 행동을 하도록 부추기는 사람.
provocateur.englishDescription: A person who provokes other people to do something.

provocateur.definitionKo: 다른 사람을 부추겨서 어떤 일이나 행동을 하도록 만드는 사람.
provocateur.englishDescription: A person who provokes other people to do something.

pruning.definitionKo: 식물이 잘 자라게 하고 열매가 많이 나게 하거나 모양을 좋게 하기 위해 가지를 자르고 다듬는 일.
pruning.englishDescription: The act of cutting and trimming the twigs of a plant, to make it grow well and bear more fruit or look good in shape.

public.englishDescription: A state of being among ordinary people.

public.definitionKo: 어떤 사물이나 사실, 내용 등을 여러 사람에게 보이는.
public.englishDescription: Showing a thing, truth, content, etc., to a lot of people.

public.definitionKo: 숨김이나 거리낌이 없이 모든 사람에게 드러나 있다.
public.englishDescription: Being open to the public, without being hidden, held back or hesitant.
A majority of people in society.
Related to the state or society.
A lot of people or a multitude of people.

public.definitionKo: 국가나 사회의 다수를 이루는 일반 대중.
public.englishDescription: People in general who account for the majority of a nation or society.
Most of the people that comprise a society.
Relating to a country or society.

pumasi.definitionKo: 힘든 일을 서로 거들어 주기 위해 돌아가며 하는 일.
pumasi.englishDescription: An exchange of labor, taking turns helping each other's laborious work.
